operations.title: The pure four-site one-loop infinity boundary is generically degree-two del Pezzo, not K3
operations.body: The general one-loop Baikov/Cayley-Menger polynomial is quadratic in squared edge variables and therefore quartic in edge variables. A linear marked-Cut residue preserves generic quartic degree. For four sites the infinity double cover of P2 is branched over a quartic, has K=-pi^*H and anticanonical square 2, hence is degree-two del Pezzo rather than K3.
